problem: Find the largest interval of continuity for the function $f(x)={log}_{2}⁡(\frac{2x+2}{3+{2}^{x}}).$
worked_solution:
Our function is a logarithmic function, so it is continuous over all points in its domain.

To find the domain of ${log}_{2}⁡(\frac{2x+2}{3+{2}^{x}}),$ we set the expression under the logarithm to be greater than zero:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{2x+2}{3+{2}^{x}}>0\,⟹\,2x+2>0\,⟹\,x>-1\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the domain of $f(x)={log}_{2}⁡(\frac{2x+2}{3+{2}^{x}})$ is $(-1,\infty ),$ and it is also continuous on this interval.
